name: Aarhus

queries.query: Aarhus Denmark official cadastral parcel map API WFS matrikelkort
queries.result: Official Aarhus GIS Portal and municipal property-information viewer found. Danish national Matriklen2 WFS is documented, but anonymous access was not available.

queries.query: Aarhus kommune matrikelkort parceller officiel WFS
queries.result: Official Aarhus GIS Portal describes municipal map services and points to Dataforsyningen for current national cadastral vector data; the property viewer is a public municipal cadastral/property map.

officialLeads.operator: Aarhus Kommune, Teknik og Miljø, Digitalisering
officialLeads.evidence: Page describes public lookup of ejendomsmæssige and matrikulære forhold and public-owned property/roads. It initializes Minimap ID 15375873-a210-4873-bc0f-ab13ddc99c19.
Official portal says it is the entry point for Aarhus map, map-data and photo solutions.

officialLeads.scope: National Danish current and preliminary cadastral WFS
officialLeads.evidence: Official transition documentation identifies this Matriklen2 WFS and its WFS 2.0 endpoint; live anonymous request required bearer authentication.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.observation: Public viewer HTML loaded; it identifies the municipal operator and Minimap ID.
Anonymous bootstrap returned profile aarhus_minimap, projected map center POINT(570907.820007324 6226395.483999639), and map scale. No parcel geometry or parcel identity returned.

Anonymous configuration returned queryable themes including theme-ejd_aarhus_havn_lois, theme-ejd_regionen_lois, theme-ejd_staten_lois, and theme-kommunale_jordstykker_lois_ikketema. This was metadata only; no feature request or unsafe attributes were made.
Legacy public DAWA coordinate-style route is gone. No inference about citywide absence was made.
Current national WFS endpoint responded Unauthorized with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. No credentials or tokens were used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Aarhus municipal public property/cadastral viewer plus national Danish Matriklen2 service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official Aarhus viewer metadata only; no anonymous parcel feature response verified.

nativeFieldMapping: Not obtained; no parcel feature response was returned.
compositeKeyProvenance: Danish parcel documentation identifies ejerlavkode + matrikelnr as a parcel lookup composite key, but no record was requested or retained.
blocker: The municipal viewer exposes anonymous configuration but its public bootstrap did not expose parcel feature geometry or safe native IDs; the national Matriklen2 WFS requires authentication.
remainingUncertainty: The municipal themes may support interactive query requests in a browser session, but no anonymous feature request was identified and no exact-point result was used to infer citywide absence.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect the viewer's documented query request format and seek a bounded geometry-plus-ID response only, without authentication or unsafe fields.
identityPolicy: Do not synthesize a parcel ID; retain only a native parcel identity if the source exposes one.
